subject: Build Playwright QA harness (fixture server + screenshot script)

detail: Run the QA harness to produce screenshots, then push_panel an image-gallery watching qa/screenshots/*.png.

subject: Fix UI issues revealed by screenshots
detail: Read the captured PNGs, identify visual bugs/rough edges, fix them, re-run the harness to verify.

subject: Server: mirror harness task ids so TaskUpdate matches (needs restart)
detail: agentSession.ts observeToolCall: TaskCreate input has no id (server invents a UUID) but TaskUpdate sends taskId "1"/"2"… so statuses never update — visible in 09-live-dogfood.png (all tasks ○ despite one in_progress). Fix: parse the TaskCreate tool_result text ("Task #N created") to capture the real id, or correlate via toolUseId on the result event. DO NOT apply while a live session runs under tsx watch — editing server src restarts the process and kills the session.

subject: Server: sort gallery files ascending by name (needs restart)
detail: server.ts expandGlob returns results.sort().reverse() so numbered captures display 09→01 in the live panel; qa/fixture-server.mjs already sorts ascending. Align the real server to ascending. Same restart caveat as the task-id fix.

subject: Composer attachments: drag-drop + paste + file picker with previews
detail: Upload endpoint saves to .clyde/uploads/; send_message carries attachment paths; agent gets "read these files" note; Slack-style thumbnail chips below the textarea and in sent bubbles.

subject: Work bar: prominent working/idle state + elapsed timer above composer
detail: Slim status bar between conversation and composer: pulsing dot + "working · 2m41s" ticking timer while a turn runs, green "idle — ready" otherwise; replaces the tiny composer status pill.

subject: FIFO message delivery: drain queue before new/idle deliveries
detail: enqueue on idle delivers new items directly, jumping persisted/queued older messages (user saw reordering). Fix: all non-urgent messages join the queue and drain FIFO; steering flushes queued items mid-turn in order before the newest; boot drains leftovers. Urgent deliberately jumps the queue.

subject: Auto-scroll conversation: follow new content unless reading history
detail: Jump to bottom on load; pin-to-bottom follows new events/deltas when already near the bottom; own main-flow sends always scroll; scrolling up unpins so history reading is never yanked.

subject: Auto-resume cut-short turns after server restart
detail: On resume boot with an empty queue: if the event log tail shows the last main-flow user_message has no turn_complete after it and the log is fresh (<30min), enqueue a visible [Auto-resume] continue message. Skip if the cut-short turn was itself an auto-resume (crash-loop guard). User chose option 2 because Clyde-builds-Clyde restarts the backend constantly.

subject: Backfill event-log holes after restarts (lost turn tails)
detail: PRIORITY RAISED 2026-08-18: second confirmed loss — the attention-surface acknowledgement prose vanished for the user during the #15 restart window; losing acknowledgements erodes trust in the document. A restart can kill the server before it consumes the tail of the SDK stream: the agent's last messages/tool calls execute but never reach events.jsonl, leaving a hole in the document (observed: a sidebar reply + TaskCreate #16 vanished; user saw it stream live, then it disappeared on reload). Fix: on resume boot, read the SDK's own session transcript (~/.claude/projects/<hash>/<sessionId>.jsonl), find messages after the last logged event, and translate+append them before starting the new query. Also: sequence intentional restarts (like the tasks.json reload touch) behind stream quiescence. DONE (merged 4215a68): backfill.ts plans from the CLI transcript on resume boot; sdkUuid stamped on all live events; 25 offline checks in qa/backfill-check.mjs (npm run qa:backfill). Proved live on its first boot — recovered the merge-train narrative the crash swallowed. Left out: quiescence-sequenced intentional restarts; mid-log holes older than the tail are unrecoverable by design.

subject: Threads metaphor: start threads anywhere, one noun (review items 4+5)
detail: Unify comments/threads into one noun: Threads. (a) Start a thread off any top-level message without selecting text — including the user's own messages; (b) keep the select-text affordance as an entry flow that seeds the thread with the highlighted quote; (c) preserve multiple threads per message anchored to different highlighted spans (user relies on this). Needs shared ThreadAnchor to make quote/span optional + server compose/anchor handling + web entry points (hover affordance on messages). DONE (merged 4215a68): ThreadAnchor span fields optional (quote present ⇔ span thread); hover ⊕ Thread affordance on every top-level message incl. the user's own; quoteless injection references the anchored message with a 200-char excerpt; multi-span threads per message preserved untouched; 04b-message-thread QA capture.

subject: Review ceremony: intake mode → distill → ask → Tasks with provenance
detail: DONE (fbb1d17 + hardening 9faa39a, wave-3 train), exactly per the settled design: ☰ Review arms the composer; the dump saves verbatim to .clyde/reviews/<batch>.md AT ENQUEUE (survives restarts); delivery injects the ceremony script (distill → echo → one clarifying AskUserQuestion → one multiSelect confirm → tasks.json edits with source/batch/declined+reason → review file annotated with ## Intake result). Reviews panel = batch burn-down lens; document badges intake messages; standing orders cover auto-detect of unprompted dumps. LIVE-FIRED TWICE on scratch haiku: run 1 exposed a real failure (haiku wrote {tasks:[…]} with title/description keys → unvalidated load killed the SDK stream) → hardened (normalizeTasks + survivable translate + shape pinned in the script); run 2 end-to-end PASS — 3 items filed with provenance, 1 declined with reason, file annotated, accepted items then implemented. Captures 02d-review-mode, 10-reviews-panel, live-11-ceremony.

Verified in 22-state screenshot run.

subject: Codify subagent orchestration: worktrees, bases, merges, gates
detail: Write the doctrine (CLAUDE.md agent-ops section + standing orders line) and fix the mechanics. Rules to encode: worktree isolation is standard for parallel implementation agents (in-tree allowed only for single web-only/read-only work); Clyde creates worktrees itself with EXPLICIT base = current HEAD (observed 2026-08-18: harness worktrees forked from session-start HEAD, missing a commit landed minutes earlier); one merge at a time, server-src merges last (each restarts the dev server); conflict protocol (coordinator resolves, agents never merge); gate = typecheck + fixture QA + live-drive before the merge commit; worktrees pruned after merge. DONE: CLAUDE.md § Agent operations (worktree standard, base pinning, brief contract, merge train, gates, cleanup) + standing-orders Delegate order now points at it. Written from lived mechanics of waves A+B (stale-base footgun, conflict-marker crash-loop avoidance, atomic ff landings).

subject: Agents panel v2: background-agent lifecycle + worktree state
detail: The R8 panel model (running until tool_result) breaks for background agents — the spawn ack lands instantly, so duration froze at 0s while agents ran (user report 2026-08-18). v2: treat backgrounded dispatches as running until a completion signal; liveness heartbeat (e.g. agent transcript/worktree mtime via a server poll); per-agent worktree column (branch, base sha, ahead-count, merged/pending); duration that actually ticks; surface the agent's final report text expandably. Server likely needs a dispatch_update event. DONE (wave-B merge): dispatch_update event parsed from task-notifications (live + backfill paths share the parser); running = no update AND (no result OR spawn ack); ticking durations, last-activity heartbeat (amber >120s), worktree branch chip, expandable final report. Verified in 10b2 capture; rail badge uses the same rule.

subject: Close the last loss window: delta journal + restart choreography
detail: DONE (7c0ada2 journal + 9faa39a follow-through, wave-3 train). Delta journal: streamed text appends to sessions/<id>/deltas-<turnId>.log as it arrives, cleared when the durable assistant_message lands or the turn completes; boot recovery (pure planJournalRecovery in backfill.ts) emits a provisional assistant_message — marked in shared + rendered with a faint 'recovered from stream' chip — only when neither events.jsonl nor the CLI transcript covers the text; sidebar markers stripped before probe and render. Choreography half was already in CLAUDE.md. BONUS same-class fix from ceremony live-fire: tasks.json shape normalization + translate() failures no longer kill the SDK stream. 11 offline checks in qa/backfill-check.mjs (46 total). Limitations noted in-code: 80-char coverage probe; recovered sidebar replies land in main flow.

detail: DONE (a38b5f9, wave-3 train): wide ≥1280 unchanged (resizers + persistence); medium <1280 one auxiliary surface at a time (React matchMedia coordination); narrow <960 capability panels + workbench become overlay drawers with scrim over a full-width conversation; phone <680 condensed top bar (no gauge/cost), rail-only nav, near-full-width drawers. localStorage describes the wide layout only; below-wide toggles are transient. subject: Thread pill cleanup: Slack-style affordance, selection-anchored popup
detail: Squeeze-in UI fix (user screenshots 2026-08-19): the hover ⊕ Thread ghost overlapped the message's first line, and the selection 💬 pill spawned at raw cursor coords from a handler on the message div only — unreliable when the drag released outside it, and styled completely differently. Fix: one shared .thread-pill (raised surface, violet accent) for both entry points; hover affordance straddles the message's top-right corner (top:-13px, opaque bg) riding the inter-message whitespace; selection popup anchors to the selection RECT via a document-level mouseup listener (works wherever the drag ends), renders above the selection (below near viewport top), viewport-clamped, dismissed on scroll, selection collapsed on click so the trailing mouseup can't resummon it. Gates: typecheck clean; 24-state fixture run green (04-selection-fab + 04b-message-thread verified by eye). Web-only — no live-drive needed. ROUND 2 (user screenshots): the straddle still clipped the previous message's last line, and :hover swapped the opaque bg for 10%-alpha --thread-soft (text ghosted through). Fix: .msg reserves a 44px right gutter (padding-right) and the affordance became an icon-only 28px circle living in it — zero text overlap at any width; hover tint now layers over the opaque base via background-image.

subject: Blocking exhibits: approve/decline pushes to the attention surface
detail: DONE (train e63e649, agent branch f73b8db, Opus 5 worktree agent). request_review MCP tool blocks exactly like AskUserQuestion: persisted exhibit event → in-memory resolver → JSON {verdict, comment} tool result, no timeout. Shared PanelContent union + one panelContentOf() used by both tools so push_panel and request_review cannot drift. Exhibits workbench tab (attention dot + auto-flip), approve/decline + comment, settled cards collapse to Ruled-on rows; symmetric expiry (server drops resolvers on abort/dispose; reducer expires pending on turn_complete/session_started) so a card never offers a verdict that reaches nobody; WorkBar names the wait ('Clyde needs a verdict on evidence'). Gates: typecheck; 34-state fixture run (26a/26b + behavioral assert that Approve really sends exhibit_response); backfill green; LIVE-FIRED (live-drive §8): haiku pushed a markdown exhibit, approve-with-comment round-tripped — the model echoed 'VERDICT approved — ship it — verified live' — and the settled row rendered (live-13/14 captures). Non-blocking variant + richer content kinds ride #33.

subject: Critic agent type: adversarial verification before acceptance
detail: DONE (train 2760c94). critic AgentDefinition in the SDK agents option — read-only by construction: tools Read/Glob/Grep/Bash, no Write/Edit/Task (Bash exists to inspect git and RE-RUN the evidence, per the refined ruling). CRITIC_PROMPT: a never-fix adversary judging against the GOAL DOC's bar, verdict as data (accept | reject | needs-human-judgment, checkable reasons, examined list); inherits the MAIN model deliberately — judgment stays frontier while implementers run the cheaper subagent model. Standing orders gained Verify-before-closing (dispatch at task-close/merge gates; surface the verdict via request_review with taskId); CLAUDE.md gate line added. LIVE-FIRED on scratch: Task dispatch with subagent_type 'critic' accepted by the SDK — dispatch event 'Critic review of haiku.txt', subagent ran ~30s in a parented tool stream and returned cleanly; the verdict-surfacing mechanism (request_review) was live-fired in the same session.

subject: Composer /btw toggle: ephemeral asides via observer query

Server pre-gathers git log/status + tasks.json + DECISIONS tail so the observer answers instead of orienting. aside/aside_started/aside_result are transient ServerMessages — never events.jsonl, never the queue, no snapshot field; reload drops cards (v1 ruling), reconnect keeps them. /btw toggle (periwinkle, mutually exclusive with ☰ Review), ephemeral card stack above the composer, cost chip per card — session gauge provably untouched. Gates: typecheck; fixture 28a/b/c with asserts (armed submit emits aside and never send_message; no card inside the conversation); backfill green; LIVE-FIRED (live-drive §7, the observer's first real run): answered in 20.9s / $0.02, sha-grounded, document message count unchanged, session stayed idle.

subject: Subagent model split: config, agent-type enforcement, picker row
detail: User-directed (2026-08-19): subagents should run on Opus 5 while the main thread stays Fable-class — encoded, not left to inheritance. config.json gains subagentModel (env CLYDE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, default claude-opus-5), carried through New-session like model/effort. Enforcement over convention: the SDK agents option defines an 'implementer' type pinned to the subagent model; #27's 'critic' defaults to the MAIN model (adversarial judgment is what the frontier model is for); standing orders route dispatches through those types so the choice is structural, not a prompt suggestion. Verified: AgentDefinition.model accepts alias or full id ('claude-opus-5'); omitted = inherit. UI: the #25 picker grows a second row (Session / Subagents), same Apply-on-idle rotation; chip shows both when they differ (e.g. fable · xhigh · agents: opus). Rationale: subagents burn most tokens on briefed implementation; Opus 5 is half Fable's price and plenty capable there. subject: Malleable exhibits: rich content vocabulary + evidence-authoring doctrine
detail: User-directed (2026-08-19): the push vein is too thin — screenshot globs with no framing, no ask, no interactivity. Level up: (a) content kinds shared by push_panel AND request_review (one union): html — a model-authored project file rendered in a sandboxed iframe (bespoke interactives, SVG/HTML plots like train/val loss curves, rich reports); table — columns/rows natively rendered; alongside image-gallery/markdown/metrics. Deliberately NO charting DSL — the model constructs the representation, that IS the malleability. (b) Markdown panels become review-AND-edit: generalize #12's goal-edit mechanics (edit in place → save to file → agent notified) to any pushed markdown panel. (c) Framing mandatory: every push carries title + detail (what this is, what judgment is wanted). (d) Doctrine, the highest-leverage half: rewrite MCP tool descriptions + standing orders to teach evidence AUTHORING with exemplars (loss curves → author SVG/HTML and push; design judgment → screenshot set + the specific ask via blocking request_review; tabular results → table; doc needing the user's pen → editable markdown; an artifact without framing is not evidence). (e) Surface routing doctrine (user, 2026-08-19): the router is the RESPONSE CONTRACT. push_panel = ambient reference → left Artifacts rail: no response expected, continuously updatable, skippable BY DESIGN (standing surfaces like a QA gallery tracking every run). request_review = judgment → right attention surface: always carries the ask, settles with a verdict; BLOCKING when the agent's next action depends on the answer, plus a non-blocking variant (tool resolves 'posted — continue non-gated work'; the verdict steers in as a delivery when the user settles it) for needs-eyes-but-don't-stall. Default to ASKING at judgment-worthy checkpoints — the skippable lane is never for 'I finished something.' The right surface stays high-signal because everything on it awaits a response; nothing there is wallpaper (attention inflation would destroy the badge's meaning). Lifecycle: settled exhibits collapse to outcome rows with verdict→task provenance; durable content can also live as a left artifact; any left artifact can be re-pushed with an ask when judgment is wanted. Sequencing: renderer half = worktree agent C after the A/B train; server schema + doctrine ride the coordinator's phase-2 agentSession pass (one writer on the hotspot); live-fire every kind on scratch incl. a real model-authored HTML plot. DONE (train 2760c94; renderer half by an Opus-5 worktree agent). html: sandbox=allow-scripts iframe only — agent-authored markup NEVER loads top-level on Clyde's origin (ruling recorded); fixture ASSERTS the inline script really executes. table: normalizeTable coerces near-misses, caps 300x40 with honest truncation, garbage renders an empty state. Markdown artifacts editable in place via POST /api/project-file (existing files only, root-confined against resolved symlinks, .clyde refused — live-probed 400s; debounced [<path> edited] +N/-M note — live-probed). Exhibit markdown stays read-only by construction (verdict comment is the feedback channel). Doctrine shipped in both tool descriptions + standing orders. LIVE-FIRED: scratch haiku AUTHORED plot.html (self-contained SVG chart) unprompted on structure and pushed it as a non-blocking html exhibit; the approve verdict delivered as an [Exhibit verdict] message after the turn had ended. 6 new captures; 40 fixture states total.

subject: CSP hardening for /api/project-file responses
detail: Follow-up flagged by the #33 renderer agent, DONE (d13c955): GET /api/project-file responses carry Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts — a direct navigation to agent-authored HTML gets an opaque origin (no Clyde APIs, no localStorage) while the exhibit iframe's allow-scripts flow is unchanged. Verified: 33x fixture asserts green (frameLocator still executes the plot's script) and the header confirmed live on the running server. CLAIM CORRECTED per critic finding 1 + #36: the CSP sandbox alone never put 'Clyde APIs out of reach' - it blocked same-origin DOM reads only; the socket and simple POSTs stayed reachable from the opaque origin until the #36 origin gate landed. The honest pair: CSP sandbox (no reads) + origin gate (no writes/socket).

subject: Left-rail audit: right items, right order, informative AND actionable
detail: User-directed (2026-08-19, overnight mandate), DONE (ea8765d + 3ea6eaf). Verdicts from visual QA of every panel: (1) the SET is right — ten items, each earning its lifecycle; nothing added (file tree stays future per SCOPE). (2) ORDER was wrong — now tells the loop: Goal → Tasks → Git → Agents → Artifacts → Decisions → Reviews, with Activity/Context/Logs bottom-anchored behind a hairline as the system cluster (introspection, apart from the working loop). (3) CONTENT: Activity was the worst offender (bare '14:12 Read' rows, lone ✓ rows) — rebuilt: one row per call, result glyph joined (✓/✗/⋯), the call's OBJECT shown (file, command, pattern, title), subagent dispatches as group headers; Reviews' legacy checklists collapsed to provenance-labeled summary rows (they read as open work when they are history — the user's exact complaint); Context drops node_modules noise and ranks by touches; commit expansion drops git-show's duplicate Author/Date preamble; empty tool-only assistant messages no longer render as empty bubbles. Tasks/Agents/Artifacts/Decisions/Goal/Logs judged strong as-is. Ceremony linkage tightened alongside (3ea6eaf): the review file must name spawned decisions. Gates: typecheck, 40 captures green (corrected per #37 — the commit message's '42' was never true), backfill green.

subject: Close the opaque-origin holes behind the CSP sandbox (critic finding 1)
detail: The #34 CSP sandbox header is real but its recorded claim is false against its own threat model: from the sandboxed opaque origin, agent-authored script can (a) open ws://localhost:<port>/ws - the WebSocketServer (server.ts:263) has no Origin check, and hello hands over the session snapshot = the event log, plus accepts every user-privileged client message (send_message, interrupt, edit_task, exhibit_response); (b) fire non-preflighted simple POSTs: /api/goal (overwrites SCOPE.md AND injects a note into the agent's turn - prompt-injection channel), /api/project-file?path= (overwrites any non-.clyde file incl. packages/server/src/* which tsx watch then EXECUTES), /api/upload. Fix: Origin check on the WS upgrade (allow the UI origin, reject null/absent), Origin guard or custom-header preflight requirement on all state-changing routes; extend qa/fixture-server.mjs to serve the CSP header on /api/project-file so fixture asserts test what the claim decorates; add assertions (offline where possible, live-drive section for the WS rejection). Also correct #34's overstated detail text when this lands. DONE (a4611cb, merge train): pure origin.ts policy (absent Origin allowed - local tools; present-and-unlisted rejected incl. the literal 'null'); HTTP gate keyed on method (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) ahead of every route; verifyClient 403 on the WS upgrade; fixture server now serves the CSP header so the evidence tests the claim; qa:origin 40/40; ephemeral-port wiring probe 9/9. SCOPE HONESTY: this closes the rendered-HTML hole only - absent-Origin local processes (curl, the agent's own shell) remain allowed by design; loopback-only allowlist means LAN access is unsupported.

subject: Agents panel: dispatch_update never fires for background dispatches (stuck 'running')
detail: Observed 2026-08-19: the critic dispatch (toolUseId toolu_01ML3Ss2Z29S2Tq939mg2THn, 11:47:48) completed in 6m14s but the Agents panel showed it running for 2+ hours. Evidence: events.jsonl has the dispatch event and ZERO dispatch_update events in the whole session, so the #23 rule (running until completion signal) never terminates for background dispatches whose spawn ack lands instantly. Likely cause: the task-notification parser (shared live+backfill per #23) does not match the current harness notification format (<task-notification><task-id>/<status>/<result> XML-ish shape) that background Agent-tool completions arrive in. Fix: update the parser to the current format(s), emit dispatch_update on completion notifications, add a backfill/offline check with a real captured notification as fixture; consider a fallback (mark completed when the coordinator's turn consumes the notification) so unrecognized future formats degrade to correct-eventually instead of running-forever. DONE (d07705a, merge train): root cause was NOT a format change - completions arrive on the live SDK stream as typed system/task_notification messages which translate() never handled; the text form exists only in the CLI transcript (backfill path, which worked). Now both forms share buildDispatchUpdate(); task_started/progress map taskId->toolUseId; report recovered from output_file (16MB cap, error-swallowing); stopped/killed map to failed (widening the union = web change, out of scope); degraded fallback scans bare toolu_ ids so only a no-id notification can ever leave a card running, warn-logged. 16 new backfill checks green; replay of the real incident transcript yields the correct update.

subject: Decisions panel: edit and delete rulings from the UI
detail: User request 2026-08-19: a way to delete and/or modify Decisions. subject: Standing orders: posture ceremony, deferral convention, binding critic
detail: agentSession.ts prompt changes (wave 1 is prompting-only): (1) CLYDE_PROTOCOL — Orientation gains ENGINEERING.md; new Change-posture bullet: on significance-trigger hits, name the plausible axes of change, default NARROW with a one-line prose posture note, record deferrals in DECISIONS.md as '- Deferred: <axis> — revisit when <trigger> (<date>)' (trigger clause written NOW so v2 tripwires can arm retroactively), and block with a question card ONLY when buying an extension point would change today's build ('not anticipated' and 'plausible-don't-build' are identical builds — never ask the user to distinguish them).
